note: T-GAM-01 (FR-GAM-01..03, D-87). Badges, weekly challenges and avatar unlockables. Rewards are ONLY for consistency, learning, recovery and function (spec 6.9): never for weight, calories, fasting, restriction, exercise volume above the plan, rankings or comparing people. Every rule counts days or completed items, never amounts. Unlocks are cosmetic only. Copy is kind (no guilt, no 'don't lose your streak'), makes no health claims and is pending clinical review; the app shows rewards only with the `rewards` flag on (dev until review). A test (test/rewards/reward_catalog_test.dart) fails on any banned reward type or word.

badges.title: First step
badges.line: You did your first small step. That's how every habit starts.

badges.title: A steady week
badges.line: 7 days of small steps, rest days included.

badges.title: Two steady weeks
badges.line: 14 days of small steps. It's becoming part of your day.

badges.title: A steady month
badges.line: 30 days of small steps. That's a real habit.

badges.title: Restart
badges.line: You came back after a break. Coming back is what counts.

badges.title: Kind restarts
badges.line: You've restarted three times. Every restart is a fresh start.

challenges.title: Post-meal walk
challenges.how: After one meal, take a short, easy walk at your own pace.

challenges.title: Plant variety
challenges.how: Add a plant food you enjoy to one meal: a fruit, a vegetable, beans, nuts or a whole grain.

challenges.title: Steady bedtime
challenges.how: Go to bed at about the same time as the night before.

challenges.title: Strength and balance
challenges.how: Do a few gentle moves that are already part of your plan, holding on to something steady.

challenges.title: Travel-ready
challenges.how: Get one small thing ready for a busy day or a trip, like a water bottle or your plan for the day.
